attempts.summary: Implemented cross-LAN firewall via Ansible: node2 (lan-a, 10.50.10.0/24) can reach node3 (lan-b, 10.50.20.0/24) only on TCP/5432 (PostgreSQL), with all other traffic between the LANs rejected by node1's VyOS forward filter. Control node4 runs the playbook (site.yml/inventory.ini/ansible.cfg under /root/cross-lan-firewall) against node1 (VyOS, via sudo-elevated vbash CLI raw commands since this image's operator account needs sudo to commit config), node2 and node3 (NetworkManager static addressing/routes, PostgreSQL install+config, firewalld port). Verified functionally (TCP 5432 allowed, TCP 22 and ICMP rejected in both directions, management network/egress unaffected) and confirmed all state and firewall behavior survive a full one-at-a-time restart of all 4 managed nodes with changed boot IDs.
